    models_bench = [m for m, v in zip(models, valid) if v]

# Also compute for raw accuracy
raw_acc = responses.mean(axis=1)
tau_raw, p_raw = kendalltau(raw_acc, ground_truth)
log.info('Raw accuracy: tau=%.4f, p=%.2e', tau_raw, p_raw)

# Load ContamCal result for comparison
cc_path = '/root/autodl-tmp/exp006/results_pooled_n24/arc_challenge/arc_challenge/irt_2pl_gamma.json'
with open(cc_path) as f:

# Convergence

min_ess = summary['N_Eff'].min()
diag = fit.diagnose()
print(f'\\nDiagnostics: max_Rhat={max_rhat:.4f}, min_ESS={min_ess:.1f}')
